title: A Tryouts for the Detention
author: Ansel Ishikawa
blurb: Petra Dunmore, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
